title: Creator Loop
summary: YTIntel now closes the loop from competitor research to your own published results, while improving mobile use, PWA integration, diagnostics, backups and startup performance.
discord_changes: New Creator Loop tracks a research-backed idea from Packaging Lab through production, publication and public outcome snapshots.
Added personal calibration so repeated published outcomes can show which packaging mechanisms fit your own channel — without pretending correlation proves causation.
Major platform hardening: faster PWA caching, mobile quick dock, share-to-YTIntel, app shortcuts, System Health and complete backups.
changes: Added a new top-level Creator Loop as the fifth stage of the core workflow: Discover → Investigate → Validate → Package → Learn.
Packaging Lab package cards can now be sent directly into Creator Loop before production begins.
Creator Loop preserves the original niche, title, concept, viewer promise, opening hook, test plan, package score, evidence fit and replication evidence beside the experiment.
Added production states for planned, producing, published and reviewed experiments.
Published experiments can store the final YouTube URL and re-run YTIntel's public analysis to capture outcome snapshots over time.
Outcome snapshots preserve public views, channel-relative outlier multiple, channel median, baseline sample size and replay availability when exposed.
Added observed post-publication view velocity between saved outcome snapshots when at least two snapshots exist.
Added creator-fit calibration across measured uploads, including above-baseline counts, breakout counts, average public outlier and title-mechanism summaries.
Personal-fit summaries stay sample-aware: fewer than three measured outcomes remain explicitly labelled as too thin for meaningful pattern claims.
Added manual experiments so creators can test ideas that did not originate in Packaging Lab.
Added copyable experiment briefs that keep the research hypothesis and latest public outcome together.
Added System Health with live checks for connectivity, the analysis API, GPT-5.6 Sol availability, service-worker control, installed-app mode and browser storage usage.
Added an in-app install button on browsers that expose the PWA installation prompt.
Added PWA share-target support so supported devices can share a YouTube URL directly into YTIntel Analyse.
Added PWA shortcuts for Command Center, Opportunity Radar, Analyse and Creator Loop.
Added URL-based tool routing for PWA shortcuts and shared links.
Added a fixed mobile quick dock for Command Center, Radar, Analyse and Creator Loop while preserving the full desktop research workspace.
Centralised draft persistence for analysis URLs, Radar searches, Similar/Channel discovery, Pattern Mine lists and Packaging Lab angles.
Added explicit offline messaging while keeping saved research accessible when the network drops.
Added reduced-motion and touch-device behaviour improvements plus safe-area-aware mobile positioning.
Added compatibility fallbacks for Array.prototype.at and CSS.escape so older usable browser engines fail less abruptly.
Removed the obsolete v0.10.6 update-only module and v0.10.8 legacy PWA/update module from the production startup path.
Rebuilt the service-worker runtime list around files the current app actually loads instead of pre-caching obsolete historical modules.
Changed versioned JS/CSS caching to cache-first with background refresh, while keeping navigation network-first and version-busted each release.
Enabled navigation preload where supported and continued automatic retirement of old YTIntel shell caches.
Upgraded Research OS backup/restore so Creator Loop experiments and current drafts are included, while remaining compatible with the existing backup schema.
Kept the single-owner shell architecture so older feature modules cannot hijack the current browser title, status or What's New experience.
Bumped the PWA identity and runtime cache to v0.15.0.
why_it_matters: YTIntel's end goal is not merely to explain competitor videos. It should help a creator discover an opportunity, validate it, build an original execution, publish it, observe what happened and improve the next decision. Creator Loop adds that missing feedback cycle while the platform changes make the app safer and faster to use repeatedly across devices. Public outcome data remains observational and is never presented as proof that YTIntel caused a video's performance.
